# telnyx_sub_number_orders (Data Source)

The account's sub number orders.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_country_code` (String) ISO alpha-2 country code.
- `filter_include_phone_numbers` (Boolean) Include the first 50 phone number objects in the results, including their per-number regulatory requirement statuses
- `filter_order_request_id` (String) ID of the number order the sub number order belongs to
- `filter_phone_number_type` (String) Phone Number Type
- `filter_phone_numbers_count` (Number) Amount of numbers in the sub number order
- `filter_status` (String) Filter sub number orders by status.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `sub_number_orders` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sub_number_orders))

<a id="nestedatt--sub_number_orders"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sub_number_orders`

Read-Only:

- `country_code` (String)
- `created_at` (String) An ISO 8901 datetime string denoting when the number order was created.
- `customer_reference` (String) A customer reference string for customer look ups.
- `id` (String)
- `is_block_sub_number_order` (Boolean) True if the sub number order is a block sub number order
- `order_request_id` (String)
- `phone_number_type` (String)
- `phone_numbers` (Attributes List) The first 50 phone numbers in the sub number order, including their per-number regulatory requirement statuses. Only present when filter[include_phone_numbers]=true is used. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sub_number_orders--phone_numbers))
- `phone_numbers_count` (Number) The count of phone numbers in the number order.
- `record_type` (String)
- `regulatory_requirements` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sub_number_orders--regulatory_requirements))
- `requirements_met` (Boolean) True if all requirements are met for every phone number, false otherwise.
- `status` (String) The status of the order.
- `updated_at` (String) An ISO 8901 datetime string for when the number order was updated.
- `user_id` (String)
